blockers.description: Massive task_id mismatch between SOP and production. 19 of 33 SOP task IDs do not have character-for-character matches in production.json. Word order reversals (FINISH_SPRAY_1 vs FINISH_1_SPRAY), naming divergence (PROTECT_LANDSCAPE vs LANDSCAPE_PROTECT, PRIME_SPRAY vs PRIME_ADHESION_SPRAY, DETAIL_JCHANNEL vs DETAIL_BRUSH), and granularity differences (SOP has 2 detail tasks but production has 1; SOP has 1 hardscape protection but production has 2; SOP has 1 equipment cleanup but production has 2).
blockers.suggested_fix: Reconcile ALL task IDs to use identical strings in both files. Recommended: use the SOP task IDs as canonical and update production to match. For granularity splits (hardscape, equipment cleanup), either split the SOP task or merge the production tasks. For detail tasks (JCHANNEL + CUTIN), either merge to one in SOP or split to two in production.

blockers.description: 5 production tasks have no SOP definition at all: TSK_VNRP_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_SPRAY, TSK_VNRP_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_BRUSH_ROLL, TSK_VNRP_CHALK_SCRUB, TSK_VNRP_INSPECT_COAT, TSK_VNRP_TOUCHUP_REPAIR. These tasks exist only in production with no corresponding SOP task defining their workflow, quality notes, or sequence position.
blockers.suggested_fix: Add corresponding SOP tasks for all 5 to appropriate modules: equipment setup tasks to MOD_VNRP_SETUP, chalk scrub to MOD_VNRP_WASH or MOD_VNRP_PREP, interstage inspection/touch-up to a new MOD_VNRP_INTERSTAGE or to MOD_VNRP_FINISH_1.

blockers.description: 5 SOP tasks have no production rate at all (even accounting for name mismatches): TSK_VNRP_MOBILIZE, TSK_VNRP_SCAFFOLD_SETUP, TSK_VNRP_WASH_MIX, TSK_VNRP_WASH_CHALK_TEST, TSK_VNRP_SCAFFOLD_TEARDOWN. These tasks are defined in SOP but the estimation engine has no rate to calculate hours.
blockers.suggested_fix: Add production rates for all 5 tasks. TSK_VNRP_MOBILIZE and TSK_VNRP_SCAFFOLD_SETUP/TEARDOWN should be FIXED-time tasks. TSK_VNRP_WASH_MIX is likely FIXED (10-15 min). TSK_VNRP_WASH_CHALK_TEST is likely FIXED or per-elevation EA.

warnings.description: Task classification mismatch for TSK_VNRP_SCUFF_SAND: SOP defines it as qt_scaled (with QT2/QT3 quality_notes differentiation), but production defines it as binary with a single rate_per_hour=200. warnings.suggested_fix: Either change production to qt_scaled with QT2 rate (higher SF/hr for spot treatment) and QT3 rate (200 SF/hr for full surface), or change SOP classification to binary if the rate is truly the same.

summary: FAIL — 3 critical blockers from cross-file task ID threading. Only 6 of 33 SOP task IDs have exact character-for-character matches in production.json (18%). The SOP Librarian and Estimation Engineer used different naming conventions for the same logical tasks — word order reversals (FINISH_SPRAY_1 vs FINISH_1_SPRAY), naming divergence (PROTECT_LANDSCAPE vs LANDSCAPE_PROTECT), prefix variations (PRIME_SPRAY vs PRIME_ADHESION_SPRAY), and granularity differences (SOP has 2 detail tasks, production merged to 1; SOP has 1 hardscape, production split to 2). Additionally, 5 production tasks have no SOP definition (equipment setup, chalk scrub, interstage inspect/touchup) and 5 SOP tasks have no production rate (mobilize, scaffold setup/teardown, wash mix, chalk test). One classification mismatch: SCUFF_SAND is qt_scaled in SOP but binary in production. One protection zone bug: utility panel task references ext_light_fixture zone. Architectural checks are strong — QT2-QT3 only, single substrate state, no DSD, no RRP, binder lock, LRV hard stop, mandatory adhesion primer all correctly enforced. The spec's domain logic is sound; the problem is purely cross-file ID synchronization between the SOP Librarian and Estimation Engineer agents.
